title: SynCardia Systems
description: syncardia.com 1.5 TB Private Finance, Regulatory, Clinical Research, Engineering, Manufacturing and other sensetive data SynCardia Systems, LLC (parent: Picard Medical, NYSE American: PMI) — Tucson-based medtech founded 2001, manufactures the world's only FDA & Health Canada approved Total Artificial Heart (TAH): complete biventricular replacement as bridge-to-transplant. 2,100+ implants, 27 countries, 120+ centers; sizes 70cc adult + 50cc for women/pediatric; portable Freedom Driver (FDA 2014) lets patients go home; next-gen fully implantable driverless Emperor TAH in development. 86% reach transplant (UNOS), 80% post-HT 1-yr survival. Revenue tiny $4.94M (2025, +12.5%) vs net loss $27M; going-concern warning, $77M accumulated deficit; CE mark lost 2022, Europe collapsing. IPO Sept 2025 at $4/share, $19.6M gross on NYSE American. Owned 85% by Hunniwell Lake/Picard (2021) after Versa Capital bought it from Chapter 11 (2016). Jarvik-7 roots (1985, Symbion/CardioWest).
